title: Add search result pagination
description: ProductGrid.tsx hardcodes totalPages=1 in search mode (line 62-63). Backend ChromaDbManager.search() already has an offset param but the frontend never sends it. Need: server.py /api/v1/search to accept page/offset, frontend ProductGrid to page through search results the same way browse mode does.
close_reason: Backend accepts page param, calculates offset, returns total_pages. Frontend passes page in search body, derives totalPages from response, shows Pagination in both browse and search modes.

title: Cache DAZ Script Server availability
description: DazScriptServerClient.is_available() calls status() which fires a live HTTP probe on every invocation. server.py endpoints like open_product call is_available() then immediately call another plugin method — 2 HTTP round-trips. Add a short TTL cache (10s) on the availability result. Affects daz_script_server.py:103-104 and server.py callers.
close_reason: Added 10s TTL cache on is_available() using time.monotonic(); _availability_cache tuple on instance, _AVAILABILITY_TTL class constant.

title: ETL async web scraping
description: scrape_product_page in postgres_db_manager.py uses time.sleep(0.2) inside a serial for-loop. For ~4000 products that is ~800s of sleep alone. Replace with async aiohttp + asyncio.Semaphore (5-10 concurrent). Affects postgres_db_manager.py:44-80 and the main() ETL loop at line 324.
close_reason: Replaced serial scrape loop with async aiohttp gather. Added _scrape_product_page_async and _scrape_all_async in postgres_db_manager.py. ETL phase now runs all HTTP scrapes concurrently under asyncio.Semaphore(ETL_SCRAPE_CONCURRENCY, default 10), then does SQLite inserts serially. Async helpers added to utilities.py. aiohttp added to pyproject.toml. Sync scrape_product_page kept for non-ETL callers.

title: Add text search in browse mode
description: Browse mode has no name/text search — only facet filters. Add a SQLite LIKE filter on the name column to SQLiteWrapper.get_products() and wire it through the /api/v1/products endpoint and the UI SearchBar. This lets users type partial product names without triggering the vector search path.

title: Fix filter active badge in browse mode
description: FilterSidebar.tsx line 71: hasActive && isSearchMode means the active-filter badge only appears in search mode. Filters also apply in browse mode. Remove the isSearchMode guard so the badge shows whenever any filter is active regardless of mode.

title: Fix script registration race condition
description: DazScriptServerClient._ensure_scripts_registered() checks _scripts_registered=False then fires all registrations then sets the flag (daz_script_server.py:108-125). Concurrent FastAPI requests can both see False and double-register. Set the flag to True before the registration loop to act as a lock.

title: PostgreSQL connection pooling in DazDBAnalyzer
description: _execute_query in daz_db_analyzer.py opens and closes a new psycopg2 connection per call (line 96). ETL batch loop calls this repeatedly. Replace with psycopg2.pool.SimpleConnectionPool or a context-managed pool so connections are reused across the ETL run.

title: Replace ChromaDB histogram with SQLite stats
description: get_db_stats() in chroma_db_manager.py fetches all document metadata from ChromaDB to build histograms (line 272). SQLiteWrapper.get_filter_values() already does this cheaply. The /api/v1/info endpoint should use SQLite for histogram data and only query ChromaDB for the document count.

title: Store and display asset_count per product
description: server.py _format_product() always sets asset_count: 0 (line 99). PostgreSQL QUERY_BODY in daz_db_analyzer.py already computes content_item_count per product. Store this in the SQLite schema and surface it in the API response and product card/detail UI.

title: Remove dead ChromaDbManager.load_sqlite_to_chroma()
description: ChromaDbManager.load_sqlite_to_chroma() in chroma_db_manager.py:221-259 is never called. generate_and_store_embeddings() in postgres_db_manager.py bypasses it and writes directly to chroma_db_manager.collection.upsert. Delete the dead method to reduce confusion.

title: Remove build/ directory artifacts from repo
description: build/lib/managers/ mirrors src/managers/ and appears to be leftover setuptools/wheel build artifacts. Add build/ to .gitignore and delete the directory from the repo.
